name: Phantom: Smiter
desc: A Tacet Discord that engages in close combat within the Tacet Field.
desc_open:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

Smiters are Tacet Discords that engage in close combat within the Tacet Field. They break their bodies into countless pieces, linked only by a faint frequency, allowing them to pass through extremely narrow spaces.
